# Maintainer context

signal-purple is a stable, independent Signal linked-device plugin for
libpurple 2 within its documented Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS scope. It is
not supported by Signal. Priorities are protocol correctness, safe lifecycle
boundaries, encrypted storage, honest compatibility claims, and a
low-support-burden user experience.

Do not claim live compatibility without dedicated-account evidence. Do not add
primary registration, calls, or backup compatibility opportunistically. Public
communication should be friendly, brief, and specific.
